# Agentic Mermaid

> Render Mermaid diagrams and make source-preserving typed edits with AI agents.

## Current capabilities

- [Live discovery and agent workflow](https://agentic-mermaid.dev/llms.txt): current families, operations, output formats and examples.
- [Agent instructions](Instructions_for_agents.md): parse, narrow, mutate, verify and serialize.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install and use the library, CLI or MCP server.

For the installed version, run `am capabilities --json` or `am llms-txt`.
Use `am --agent-instructions` for the workflow shipped with that installation.
